about.en: FC Barcelona Fan Token (BAR) is the official fan token of FC Barcelona, issued by Socios.com on the Chiliz Chain, where it lives at 0x1589248b4b61ed472cc21ca1f2114d93ab6910d5. Holders use it on the Socios.com app to vote in club polls and to access rewards and fan experiences; it gives no ownership of the club.
